2390-6125-6191.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2390-6125-6191.description:
Gain life.
Fiendish Panda triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it
All Will Be One triggers, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Bloodthirsty Conqueror triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

206-5078-6650-8171.easyPrerequisites: The Lunar Whale has attacked this turn.
206-5078-6650-8171.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Vraska triggers, creating a 1/1 Sculpture Treasure artifact creature token.
Activate the token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

533-4522-7839.easyPrerequisites: You control another creature or artifact.
533-4522-7839.notablePrerequisites: Quest for Pure Flame has at least four quest counters on it.
533-4522-7839.description:
Activate Quest for Pure Flame by removing four quest counters from it and sacrificing it.
Activate Makeshift Munitions by paying {1} and sacrificing another creature or artifact, dealing 2 damage to Smaug due to Quest for Pure Flame.
Smaug triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat from step 2

1496-4399-4518-6626.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and The Wind Crystal.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Verdant Sun's Avatar triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Kor Skyfisher. When it enters, it and Verdant Sun's Avatar trigger.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Verdant Sun's Avatar trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
1496-4399-4518-6626.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Kor Skyfisher for the first time.

1575-5315-5903.description:
Activate Ravenous Intruder by sacrificing an artifact, which is a Food due to Gourmand's Talent.
Nuka-Cola Vending Machine triggers, creating a tapped Treasure token.
Resolve the Ravenous Intruder ability.
Repeat.

1168-1362-1479.description:
Play Oboro, Palace in the Clouds.
When Oboro, Palace in the Clouds enters the battlefield, Toggo and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
In response, activate Oboro's first ability by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Oboro's last ability by paying {1}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Toggo trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Oboro from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Oboro, Palace in the Clouds enters the battlefield, Toggo triggers.
Repeat from step 3.

5686-7084-7396.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Quintorius, History Chaser triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

147-2292-3505.description:
Cast Second Sunrise by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Second Sunrise.
Holding priority, activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Second Sunrise
Resolve the Second Sunrise copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

1651-2751-3349-4659.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Glissa triggers, choosing the first mode.
Holding priority, activate Strionic Resonator by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Glissa's trigger.
Resolve the copy of Glissa's trigger, creating two Incubator tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the Incubators, untapping Strionic Resonator.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing an Incubator, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 2.

4968-6260-6593.description:
Cast Gatta and Luzzu by paying {2}{W}.
When Gatta and Luzzu enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Deathbringer Thoctar.
Activate Deathbringer Thoctar by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, targeting itself, but instead putting two +1/+1 counters on it due to Gatta and Luzzu and Caradora.
Activate Deathbringer Thoctar by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat from step 3.
4968-6260-6593.notes: You can forego step 4 to simply put infinite +1/+1 counters on Deathbringer Thoctar if desired.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

1270-3868-6291.description:
Activate Prosperous Partnership by tapping three creatures, creating a Treasure token and three 1/1 Thopter artifact creature tokens.
Repeat.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

955-1256-1270-5477.description:
Activate Jade Mage by paying {2}{G}, creating three 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Activate the Saprolings by tapping them, adding {2}{G}.
Repeat.

2254-3277-5626.notablePrerequisites: You have at least five creature cards in your graveyard, and one of those creature cards has mana value 1 or less.
2254-3277-5626.description:
Cast Songs of the Damned by paying {B}, adding {B} for each creature card in your graveyard.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}, sacrificing Izzet Chronarch, and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning a creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying an amount of {E} equal to Izzet Chronarch's mana value, sacrificing the creature you returned in step 4, and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning Izzet Chronarch from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Izzet Chronarch enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Songs of the Damned from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

342-804-1729-4385-4481.notablePrerequisites:
Heavy Arbalest attached to Shelob.
Shelob does not have summoning sickness.
342-804-1729-4385-4481.description:
Activate Shelob by tapping it, dealing 2 damage to Sliver Queen.
Sliver Queen dies as a state-based action due to Shelob's deathtouch, triggering Shelob, creating a token copy of Sliver Queen that is a Food artifact.
Activate the Sliver Queen token by paying {0}, creating a 1/1 Sliver creature token.
Repeat step 3.

1225-1432-3499-4091.notablePrerequisites:
Aphetto Alchemist and Ioreth of the Healing House do not have summoning sickness.
There is at least one other legendary creature on the battlefield.
The Eleventh Hour has exactly two lore counters on it.
1225-1432-3499-4091.description:
At the beginning of your precombat main phase, The Eleventh Hour triggers, putting a lore counter on itself.
The Eleventh Hour's third chapter ability triggers, creating a token copy of Aphetto Alchemist that is a legendary creature named Prisoner Zero.
Activate Ioreth of the Healing House's second ability by tapping it, untapping Prisoner Zero and any other legendary creature.
Activate Prisoner Zero by tapping it, untapping Ioreth of the Healing House.
Repeat from step 3.

224-2026-2653-4967.notablePrerequisites: Voyaging Satyr does not have summoning sickness.
224-2026-2653-4967.description:
Activate Thawing Glaciers by paying {1} and tapping it, searching your library for a basic land card and putting it onto the battlefield tapped.
The land enters the battlefield, triggering Retreat to Coralhelm and Nissa.
Resolve the Nissa trigger, adding {1}.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Voyaging Satyr.
Activate Voyaging Satyr by tapping it, untapping Thawing Glaciers.
Repeat.

824-1295-2541-4289.notablePrerequisites:
At least one +1/+1 counter on Benthic Biomancer.
Leech Bonder does not have summoning sickness.
824-1295-2541-4289.description:
Cast Thassa's Oracle by paying {U}{U}.
Thassa's Oracle triggers.
In response, activate Leech Bonder's ability from Cryptolith Rite by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Leech Bonder's second ability by paying {U} and untapping it, moving the +1/+1 counter from Benthic Biomancer to Thassa's Oracle.
Activate Leech Bonder's ability from Cryptolith Rite by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Leech Bonder's second ability by paying {U} and untapping it, moving the +1/+1 counter from Thassa's Oracle to Benthic Biomancer.
Benthic Biomancer triggers, causing you to loot.
Repeat steps 3 through 7 until the number of cards in your library is equal to your devotion to {U}.
Resolve Thassa's Oracle's ability, winning the game.

730-907-1479.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
730-907-1479.description:
Play Selesnya Sanctuary.
When Selesnya Sanctuary enters the battlefield, it, Emeria Angel, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Selesnya Sanctuary trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Emeria Angel trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Selesnya Sanctuary from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Selesnya Sanctuary enters the battlefield, it and Emeria Angel trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

3356-3385.description:
Cast Polyraptor by paying {6}{G}{G}.
When Polyraptor enters the battlefield, Aether Flash triggers, dealing 2 damage to Polyraptor.
Polyraptor triggers, creating a token copy of itself.
Repeat from step 2 using the new Polyraptor token instead.
3356-3385.notes: This combo will result in a mandatory infinite loop. Left unchecked, this will cause the game to end in a draw.
